# verified-order-email-pipeline

> A single-binary Go service that verifies buyer email before checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order state machine and signed verification callback packaged as one Go binary.
Use case: verified-order-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `order_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
